test_sanitize_plugin_name: test the _sanitize_plugin_name function rejects path-traversal attempts while accepting valid plugin names
test_resolve_git_url: test the _resolve_git_url function resolves owner/repo shorthand to full GitHub HTTPS URLs and passes through full URLs
test_read_manifest: test the _read_manifest function reads valid YAML manifests and returns empty dict for missing or invalid files
test_cmd_install: test the cmd_install function installs plugins from git URLs with manifest validation and path sanitization
test_cmd_update: test the cmd_update function updates plugins by running git pull in the plugin directory
test_cmd_remove: test the cmd_remove function removes plugins by deleting their directory and handles missing plugins
test_cmd_list: test the cmd_list function lists installed plugins with their manifest name and version
test_copy_example_files: test the _copy_example_files function copies .example config files without overwriting existing files
test_prompt_plugin_env_vars: test the _prompt_plugin_env_vars function prompts for missing env vars with support for secret inputs via getpass
test_discover_memory_providers: test the _discover_memory_providers and _discover_context_engines functions discover plugin providers with graceful fallback on import errors
test_save_memory_provider: test the _save_memory_provider and _save_context_engine functions persist provider and engine selections to config.yaml
test_curses_radiolist: test the curses_radiolist function returns default or cancel selection when not running in a TTY
